0x00080A.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000903.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x00097D.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B68.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000BBC.en: 「I messed up...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D0D.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000DB9.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000E06.en: 「Well, I'm done for. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E44.en: 「Kyah! The rest is up to you!」

0x000E8B.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000F36.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010DF.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001126.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00115B.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x001247.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x001295.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00137F.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013BD.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013EC.en: 「I can't go on any longer. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x001477.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00180A.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018DF.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x00192F.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Riston Province, Quait City

0x00196F.en: 「...Told to take a break for a while, huh.@ So, what now?」

0x0019BF.en: 「If we've got time, I'd like to look for Leona and the others.」

0x0019FC.en: 「Yeah. Let's search this area for now.@ Yang Long, is there anything nearby?」

0x001A73.en: 「Let's see... there's the Valley of Spores.」

0x001AD2.en: 「But the scale is nothing like on the surface.@ It's a place unique to La Gias.」

0x001B43.en: 「Hmm, something about that gets to me.@ Lieutenant, let's go check it out.」

0x001B9F.en: 「What, a hunch?@ You saying our friends are in the Valley of Spores?」

0x001C23.en: 「Then let's go take a look.@ Though lately your hunches haven't been worth much.」

0x001CAD.en: 「Gennacy, show them the way.@ I have some business to attend to.」

0x001D2F.en: 「Master, you're still troubled by@ what General Kirkus said, aren't you.」

0x001D8E.en: 「Yes. Why keep us on standby at@ a time like this...? By rights he should be@ requesting a recon-in-force toward the capital.」

0x001E4C.en: 「I've suspected it for a while,@ but this affair confirmed it.@ General Kirkus is hiding something from me.」

0x001EDF.en: 「Something he can't let you learn... which is...」

0x001F25.en: 「I'll confirm it by other means.@ ...Not that I find it desirable.」

0x001F81.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Riston Province, Valley of Spores

0x00200F.en: 「Um... is it really okay@ to climb out of our units?」

0x002062.en: 「We came all this way, I want to see it up close!」

0x0020A5.en: 「Well, it's not like we'll turn into mushroom people.」

0x0020E8.en: 「Hmm, so fairy-tale.@ Might be the perfect date spot.」

0x002175.en: 「This place looks pretty big.@ Wouldn't it be handy for staying hidden, too?@ Let's head deeper in and check it out.」

0x002239.en: 「No, in our units.@ We might run into enemies, after all.」

0x002295.en: 「If that happens, Tasuku... you'll pay for it later.」

0x002303.en: 「Obviously, since you're the one who suggested it.」

0x00234C.en: (The lieutenant's the one who decided...@ ah, better not say that out loud.)

0x0023F8.en: 「She's a fickle woman...@ I'm prepared for her to blow me off.」

0x00244E.en: 「Master, a contact on radar.@ It seems she's arrived.」

0x0024CF.en: 「Heh, a good woman keeps a man waiting.」

0x00252E.en: 「So, what do you want, calling me out here?@ We're enemies, you know.」

0x00258D.en: 「I know.@ I contacted you because there's something I want to ask you directly.」

0x002611.en: 「It's about Prince Feil-Lord.@ ...Has he truly passed away?」

0x00266D.en: 「You called me out to ask that?@ Ask Kirkus, not me.」

0x002712.en: 「Hmm, is that so.@ Kirkus is hiding it. Interesting.」

0x0027CA.en: 「...I'll call that old debt of yours settled with this.@ You've no complaints with that, surely.」

0x002838.en: 「Fine, I'll tell you.@ Prince Feil-Lord is alive.」

0x002891.en: 「So it's true, then...@ And where is the prince now?」

0x0028E1.en: 「That's the end of our talk. Something's approaching.」

0x00293A.en: 「If I'm seen meeting with you,@ I won't get off lightly either.」

0x0029C4.en: 「...Prince Feil is to the west right now.@ Seems he's scheming all sorts of things,@ so you may get to meet him before long.」

0x002A8B.en: (But if Prince Feil is alive,@ then I must keep my promise... the one I made to him.)

0x002B05.en: 「Master, a massive flying object is@ approaching us.」

0x002BC9.en: 「Yes, it matches the data@ we received from Lieutenant Katina.」

0x002C22.en: 「So they were summoned to <La Gias> too.@ Let's make contact with them.」

0x002CB5.en: 「...That unknown@ doesn't seem to intend to attack us.」

0x002D34.en: 「Captain, transmission from the unknown.@ They identify as Huang Yang Long,@ pilot of the Elemental Lord Granveil.」

0x002DE0.en: 「If what he says is true, he may be@ connected to Masaki Andoh.」

0x002E48.en: 「Let's confirm it.@ Eun, put him through.」

0x002E96.en: 「...This is Huang Yang Long.@ Am I correct that you are Colonel Lefina Enfield,@ commander of the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x002F29.en: 「! How do you know of me...?」

0x002F57.en: 「I heard about you from@ Lune Zoldark and@ Lieutenant Katina Tarask.」

0x002FFD.en: 「Yes. They're in the nearby Valley of Spores right now.」

0x003043.en: 「The Valley of Spores...@ isn't that where we were just now?」

0x003093.en: 「Then it seems we crossed paths.@ If you're going to join them, I'll come along.」

0x003144.en: 「We're almost at the edge of the valley.」

0x003166.en: 「Nobody here after all. Guess we head back.」

0x0031CB.en: 「To run into that bunch here...!@ So the intel about a warship in the@ Valley of Spores was a bust.」

0x00325B.en: 「Shitednia's goons! Told you so!@ You're getting punished later, Tasuku!」

0x0032E2.en: 「Granveil should be near here too...@ Contact Ensign Grenor and have her rush over.」

0x0033BA.en: 「Here we go! You'll pay for@ shaming General Jesuha!」

0x00343E.en: 「Strange, they're too well-coordinated.@ Were they deployed here for some other purpose?」

0x0034C2.en: 「So those are the surface-dwellers@ who drove off General Jesuha. How to put it...@ a lot of tacky-looking machines.」

0x003555.en: 「Ensign Grenor! At least while we're on operations,@ do something about the way you talk!」

0x0035E8.en: (So nitpicky, this one.@ It's my policy. I can't just change it that easily.)

0x003659.en: 「A bit of a nuisance. Should I call Yang Long?」

0x003711.en: 「Look, look look look!@ It's the Hiryu Kai, Lieutenant Katina!」

0x00376D.en: 「All right, I'll call your punishment even for this.」

0x0037AD.en: 「What an enormous ship...!@ It's bigger than a Sodium-class!」

0x0037FD.en: 「A surface-dweller warship!?@　If it came here alongside the Granveil,@　has it thrown in with Langran!?」

0x0038D0.en: 「Yes. They tried to bring Lieutenant Katina's@　group over, and when that failed,@　they gave chase.」

0x00394D.en: 「Understood.@　Then this ship will join the battle as well.@　All forward main guns, VLSM, ready to fire!」

0x0039CE.en: 「Bringing the Hiryu along...@　nice work, Yang Long.」

0x003A36.en: 「Just good luck.@　They were trying to leave the Valley of Spores.」

0x003A8F.en: 「If the Hiryu's here, we've got this!@　Let's crush those Shutedonias bastards all at once!」

0x003B12.en: 「Ngh, again! I won't forget this humiliation!」

0x003B58.en: 「N-not bad at all! You just remember this!」

0x003BCF.en: 「Then order all units back to the ship.@　Let's hear their story in full.」

0x003C5C.en: 「...I see. I understand the situation now.@　I'm glad Lieutenant Katina and the others@　are safe. Lieutenant Kyosuke included, of course.」

0x003D47.en: 「And, um... is there still no word@　on where Leona and Ensign Excellen@　and the others are...?」

0x003DC5.en: 「Yes... After this ship was summoned to La Gias,@　our engines were damaged... so we stayed in@　the Valley of Spores to make repairs.」

0x003E6D.en: 「But with the Hiryu along, wouldn't it be@　easier to search for Masaki and the rest?」

0x003ED5.en: 「But that also means we'll be drawn in earnest@　into La Gias's war.」

0x003F5B.en: 「True... but until we find the missing,@　we'll have to remain in this world.」

0x003FE4.en: 「We got chased down by the Shutedonias forces.@ We owe them no courtesy, that's for sure.」

0x00406A.en: 「Besides, once this war settles, Langran@　will arrange to send us back to the surface.」

0x0040EA.en: 「The Hagane is likely in La Gias too.@　Unless we regroup the Steel Dragon Squadron@　and return to the surface, we can't fulfill@　our true duty.」

0x0041BC.en: 「If the Shutedonias forces mean to stand@　in our way, then I believe combat with@　them is unavoidable.」

0x004283.en: 「I intend to head to General Kirkus now.@　I may be able to learn something there@　about the other surface-dwellers.」

0x00439F.en: 「Yes.@　Masaki saved us many times on the surface.@　This isn't exactly repaying that debt, but...」

0x004435.en: 「You, who pilot the same Masou Kishin as he does,@ are someone I judge worthy of trust.」

0x0044A0.en: 「Thank you, Colonel Lefina.@　Then, allow me to guide you to General Kirkus.」
